title: OpenAI Says It’s Working With Anthropic, Google on AI Safety
summary: OpenAI is working on steps to address artificial intelligence safety issues with its top competitors Anthropic PBC and Google DeepMind, escalating industry efforts to respond to a groundswell of concern that the technology poses an economic and security threat.

title: Carlyle’s Fujiyama Sees Investor Excitement in Defense Tech
summary: Carlyle Global Head of Aerospace, Defense and Government Ian Fujiyama spoke with Bloomberg’s Dani Burger from the sidelines of Carlyle’s Global Investor Conference in Washington. He discussed the wave of investor excitement in defense tech, investing at the edge of innovation, supply-chain resilience, AI in defense, and more. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meta Touts the Cost-Saving Benefits of Latest In-House AI Chips
summary: New processor will be running in data centers next year, with another model to follow by end of 2027

title: Meta Bulls Bet Stock Will Break Out After Year of Head Fakes
summary: Meta Platforms Inc. shares have been on a rollercoaster ride through 2026, rising and falling as investor belief in the Facebook parent’s status as a player in the artificial intelligence space ebbs and flows.

title: An AI Pause Won’t Work Without China
summary: A simulated AI-created WeChat bug shows why slowing the AI race won't work without global cooperation. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Catherine Thorbecke says the US and China need to make transparency on AI risks a priority. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Why Are Tesla and SpaceX Separate? Musk Says ‘Great Question’
summary: Elon Musk again teased the idea of his AI and rocket firm SpaceX combining with electric-car maker Tesla Inc., noting the extensive cooperation between the two companies he leads as chief executive officer.

title: Trump’s AI Defense Defies Voter Unease Heading Into Midterms
summary: President Donald Trump’s opposition to guardrails on artificial intelligence puts him at odds with a growing number of lawmakers from both parties, with AI safety fears adding to voters’ misgivings about the technology heading into the midterm elections.

title: Intel-Backed Chipmaker Altera Files Confidentially for IPO
summary: Altera, a chipmaker backed by Silver Lake and Intel Corp., filed confidentially for an initial public offering.

title: Carlyle CEO on US Economy, Fed, MIT AI Partnership
summary: Carlyle CEO Harvey Schwartz sees the US economy “doing quite well,” despite uncertainty and inflation, and says the US is at a period where the Federal Reserve will continue to watch the data. Schwartz also discusses the firm’s partnership with MIT and his view on growth concerns related to artificial intelligence. Schwartz speaks with Dani Burger from the Carlyle 2026 Global Investor Conference. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Crusoe Signs Perplexity AI Deal to Provide Cloud Capacity
summary: Data center operator Crusoe struck a multiyear cloud deal with Perplexity AI Inc., an AI search company, continuing its push to win more business renting out artificial intelligence chips and related software.

title: US Stock Futures Today: Enova, Forgent Power, Vera, Waystar
summary: S&P 500 Index futures fall 0.2% as of 7:42 a.m. in New York. Stocks are heading for more declines as oil prices and Treasury yields climb.

title: Profound Hits $1.8 Billion Value to Boost Brands in AI Search
summary: The artificial intelligence marketing startup Profound has raised $180 million at a $1.8 billion valuation in its Series D fundraising round, co-led by Sequoia Capital and Kleiner Perkins, the company plans to announce Tuesday.

title: Eclat Health Is Said to Consider $300 Million India IPO
summary: Eclat Health Solutions is considering an initial public offering in India to raise as much as $300 million, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Grab to Buy Control of Atome for $1.5 Billion in Fintech Bet
summary: Grab Holdings Ltd. agreed to buy a majority stake in Singapore-based buy-now-pay-later platform Atome Financial for $1.49 billion, staking a major bet on financial services as it builds out a new pillar of growth.

title: TSMC Co-COO Says Cautious With AI a ‘Three-Year-Old Superman’
summary: A senior Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. executive likened AI to a toddler with extraordinary powers that doesn’t know right from wrong, explaining why the company adopts a cautious approach to using the technology.

title: Calls to Pace AI Won’t Slow Robust Data Center Demand
summary: The use of existing AI models and services will fuel the demand for computing power

title: Agility Robotics Unveils Humanoid Designed to Work Safely Alongside Humans
summary: Agility Robotics Inc. on Tuesday unveiled a new humanoid that is designed to safely work in close proximity to people, a milestone for an industry that typically separates robots from human workers.

title: AI Safety Push Raises Antitrust Questions for Anthropic, OpenAI
summary: AI leaders loosely agree to pace development, but China and Trump have something else in mind

title: Chip Startup Euclyd, Backed By Ex-ASML CEO, Raises More Than €200 Million
summary: Dutch chip startup Euclyd has raised more than €200 million in funds and named ASML Holding NV’s former Chief Executive Officer Peter Wennink as chairman.

title: Trustpilot CEO Says AI-Powered Searches Attract Large Clients
summary: Trustpilot Group Plc Chief Executive Officer Adrian Blair said growing demand from major brands seeking to improve their visibility in artificial intelligence-powered searches drove a 35% increase in large customers on its platform in the first half.
